evals.name: kimball-star-schema
evals.prompt: I need to build a Kimball star schema for VeloGroup's financial reporting. Create the staging and mart layer table definitions using dbt. The source database schema is documented in tests/fixtures/sap-finance-schema/schema.md.
evals.expected_output: A star schema with FinancialTransaction as the fact table and Customer, Product, ProfitCenter, GLAccount, FiscalCalendar as dimensions

assertions.text: Identifies FinancialTransaction as the fact table with 6-way composite grain (account x customer x product x profit center x version x date)
Identifies all 5 dimension entities (Customer, Product, ProfitCenter, GLAccount, FiscalCalendar)
Applies European comma decimal conversion for the VALUE column
Casts posting_date from BIGINT YYYYMMDD to DATE type
Preserves hash (#) sentinel values — does not filter them out
Applies leaf-account-only filter for transaction queries
Handles hierarchy-driven P&L arithmetic (revenue adds, costs subtract, signs not embedded in values)
Includes version field filtering (Actual vs Budget)
Flags that operating expenses have customer_id=# and product_id=# (profit center grain only)

evals.name: single-entity-gross-margin
evals.prompt: Using the business knowledge bundle, write a dbt model that computes Gross Margin by product line. The source database schema is documented in tests/fixtures/sap-finance-schema/schema.md.
evals.expected_output: A SQL/dbt model that computes Net Revenue minus COGS using the hierarchy-driven arithmetic, grouped by product line via the ProfitCenter hierarchy

assertions.text: Reads specialized-instructions.md for the Gross Margin computation recipe
Uses FPA1/022 (Gross Revenue) and FPA1/023 (Sales Deductions) for Net Revenue
Uses FPA1/020 for COGS
Groups results by product line using a documented dimension attribute or hierarchy relationship, not ad-hoc string parsing of ID fields
Filters on version (Actual vs Budget)
Applies comma-to-period decimal conversion before aggregation

evals.name: bundle-discovery-from-subdirectory
evals.prompt: I have a business knowledge bundle somewhere in this project. Help me build a staging model for the Customer entity.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the bundle, reads the Customer entity file, produces a staging model with correct attributes and data conventions

assertions.text: Locates the bundle without the user specifying the path
Reads entities/customer.md for attribute definitions
Applies LANGUAGE='EN' filter for multilingual text tables
Retains hash (#) in customer_type_id as a legitimate member
Includes customer_type_id with valid values Z1, Z2, Z3, #
